Response B is the better summary. Its facts are accurate: the 7-2 vote, the 1 December start, the $38,000 in existing fines, the 60-day replacement rule, and the inter-library loan exception are all correct. It reports the $52,000 and $19,000 figures as stated in the source, without drawing conclusions from them. It omits the blocked-account detail, a minor gap. At roughly 129 words, it slightly exceeds the 120-word limit but is close.

Response A has a substantive accuracy problem. It calculates a "net cost of about $33,000" by subtracting the $19,000 staff-time figure from the $52,000 revenue. The source doesn't say that staff time saved would offset revenue this way, so presenting it as the net cost is an unsupported inference that could mislead a manager. It is also well over the word limit, at roughly 190 words, and its bullet structure adds length without adding necessary information.

Verdict: B
